Subject: Demo on Nov 19 — need to reschedule

Hi Marissa,

Apologies for the late notice — travel came up and I need to be out of office on the 19th. We had the demo scheduled for Nov 19 at 10am PT; can we move it? Preferably to the week of Nov 23.

Two constraints for the reschedule:
- We need to give your team at least 48 hours to prep. We want the demo to cover our prompt sets and workload traces so we can validate latencies.
- I need access checklist items completed for our staging bucket (S3 prefix) before the run so our engineers can follow along.

Available windows: Nov 24 morning PT (8-11am) or Nov 25 afternoon PT (1-4pm). If those don't work, propose 2-3 options and we can pick.

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan Smith

Hi Jordan — no problem, thanks for the heads up. Nov 24 morning PT (9am PT) or Nov 25 at 2pm PT both work from our side.

I’m looping in Laura (solutions) to coordinate prep: prompt sets, workload traces, and access checklist. Laura — can your team have the prompt-set PDF and a short sample workload run (latency traces) ready by EOD Nov 22 if we confirm Nov 24? Also, can you confirm what access you need from Acme so we can send an actionable checklist to Jordan’s team?

Jordan/Maya — if you can drop the S3 prefix and any sample prompts into the Drive folder below that will speed things up: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-demo-prep

Proposed: Nov 24, 9am PT (60-75 mins) — demo + 15 mins for post-demo next steps. If you prefer Nov 25 at 2pm PT let me know and we’ll lock that instead.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Date: 2026-11-19T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Acme demo prep — prompt sets + access checklist

Laura / Rishi — quick internal note after Jordan asked to reschedule to give us time to prep. TL;DR: customer needs prompts + workload traces covered and wants staging access checklist completed before the run.

Action items:
- Laura: prepare prompt-set-v2.pdf (customer-facing) with 8-10 representative prompts and expected output framing. Can you include one short section on expected output quirks for retail search (synonym handling)? Target: EOD Nov 22.
- Rishi: run a small sample workload (approx 1k tokens/session, 50 sessions) against the candidate model and export latency/CPU/GPU traces. Put the CSV in the drive folder and include a 1-paragraph summary. Target: Nov 22 COB.
- Both: create access-checklist.md for Acme (IAM roles, S3 prefix, ephemeral keys, IP allowlist steps). I started a draft and attached it here (access-checklist.md). Please iterate.

Notes: Marissa will send the checklist to Jordan and Maya once we have final items and confirm the Nov 24 slot.

Thanks — Marissa
From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme-retail.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Maya Chen <maya.chen@acme-retail.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>

Marissa, Laura — Nov 24 at 9am PT works for us. Thanks for the quick turnaround on prep. We uploaded a small sample of prompts and the S3 prefix details to the Drive folder you shared.

I confirm the access items we need: read-only IAM role for the staging bucket, scoped temporary credentials for the demo window, and an allowlist for our office IPs. Please send the finalized access-checklist and any pre-demo instructions by Nov 22 so our infra team can action.

Confirmed: Nov 24, 9am PT (Calendar invite accepted).

Cheers,
Jordan
